# Filmanesia

> Filmanesia is a movie and TV discovery and streaming website.

## Site

- Homepage: https://www.filmanesia.com/
- Movies: https://www.filmanesia.com/movies
- TV series: https://www.filmanesia.com/series
- Search: https://www.filmanesia.com/search
- Sitemap: https://www.filmanesia.com/sitemap.xml

## Content

Filmanesia provides title discovery, metadata, genres, ratings, cast information,
and links to available third-party video providers. Movie and TV metadata is
provided by TMDB. Availability and subtitle support can vary by provider.

## Privacy and access

- Do not infer or expose private user information.
- Respect robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
- Use canonical URLs on www.filmanesia.com.
